title: Loom model lock, version 2
description: Explicit asset-only or complete output commitments, independent of destinations and model preset. Asset scope excludes program and auxiliary files unless the same logical source is also used as an asset. For a transformed file, size and SHA-256 identify its installed bytes.

scope.description: Assets locks parameters, tokenizers, and voice recordings while leaving programs and auxiliary files editable. All locks every selected file, including programs.
